definition.def: If one thing denotes another, it is a sign or indication of it. [formal]
examples: Red eyes denote strain and fatigue. [VERB noun]
There was a message waiting, denoting that someone had been here ahead of her. [VERB that]

definition.def: What a symbol denotes is what it represents. [formal]
examples: In figure 24 'D' denotes quantity demanded and 'S' denotes quantity supplied. [VERB noun]

definition.def: What a word or name denotes is what it means or refers to. [formal]
examples: In the Middle Ages the term 'drab' denoted a very simple type of woollen cloth which was used by peasants to make their clothes. [VERB noun]
